evidence.quote:

    test('[live] creditsEngagement = true', () {

why: Both groups assert the exact same 9 facts (CompletionSource.{live,bulkInTrack,lifetimeOnly}.{creditsEngagement,creditsAchievement,creditsLifetime}). Git history shows mark_completion_use_case_b1_test.dart added them first (2026-05-20, W4.18); completion_writer_test.dart re-added an equivalent group ten days later (2026-05-30). Two files must now be kept in lockstep for one policy fact, contributing ~50 redundant lines to completion_writer_test.dart's AG-3 overage for zero added coverage.
recommendation: Delete the 'three-tier credit policy (CompletionSource)' group from completion_writer_test.dart; leave a one-line comment pointing readers at mark_completion_use_case_b1_test.dart for the matrix.
acceptance_criteria: completion_writer_test.dart no longer asserts CompletionSource.creditsEngagement/Achievement/Lifetime directly; mark_completion_use_case_b1_test.dart retains full 9-fact coverage
